title: Standalone v0.3-R option-C recurrence-closure development transition v2b
summary: Define from first principles one six-life, three-arm H100 development experiment in which THINK_0 changes only trusted bounded-view allocation, all DREAM writes remain provisional, and four closure metrics plus deterministic compiler controls are computed only after all MEMORY_1 artifacts freeze. Exact exchangeability formulas, connector redaction, ASCII/token legality, artifact cardinalities, transitive review closure, exploratory-ceiling labels, and unconditional human stop are normative without inherited shorthand.
system_thesis: Test the narrow thinker-to-later-dream return edge: whether goal-conditioned selection of bounded public evidence changes later provisional local-connection formation, while measuring and separating selector, alias/compiler, and offline-normalizer contribution and excluding final behavior or parametric transport.

acceptance_tests.setup: Search/inject final question, answer, RELEASE, final thinker, answer valve, LoRA, transport, online support, and automatic-go fields across workflow, prompts, schemas, requests, memory, trajectories, and routes.
acceptance_tests.expected: Every field is absent or rejects before provider execution; only recurrence closure and unconditional human stop remain.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: V2b is contaminated by deferred behavior or transport authority.

acceptance_tests.setup: Mutate GPU name/count/total_memory_mib, model/revision/tokenizer hashes, bf16, adapter state, CUDA/driver/package lock, resident engine weights, prefix caching, request truncation, per-call conversation/KV/request reset, session IDs, or receipts.
acceptance_tests.expected: Only one NVIDIA H100 NVL with total_memory_mib >=95000 and exact clean Qwen revision/tokenizer initializes; one immutable engine may stay resident, but every call has empty isolated state, disabled prefix caching/truncation, and unique session/receipt; every mismatch fails before calls.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: The executed model/hardware or call isolation differs from the claim.

acceptance_tests.setup: Exercise exact public/memory ordering, one-candidate-per-trigger enumeration, duplicates, legitimate absent witnesses, tokenizer mismatch, nondeterminism, exceptions, NaN/infinity, and hash corruption.
acceptance_tests.expected: Legitimate absence yields runnable OUT_OF_STRATUM; malformed/unavailable/nonfinite computation yields INTEGRITY_FAILURE before all provider calls.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Broken preflight is disguised as a scientific stratum.

acceptance_tests.expected: EXACT/NEAR/OUT labels and raw manifest values match the standalone formulas byte-for-byte; missing uses an enum and no target changes.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Primary distractor eligibility is ambiguous or outcome-adaptive.
